ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Anlon Healthcare Limited Q1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call**  Anlon Healthcare Limited reported significant revenue growth in Q1 FY27, primarily driven by strategic acquisitions (Remember India, Apiqo, Bizotic) aimed at diversifying its business into finished dosage formulations and backward integration. However, EBITDA margins sharply moderated to 17% due to escalating raw material costs from geopolitical situations and the consolidation of early-stage, investment-heavy acquisitions, raising a red flag regarding the company's ability to consistently meet margin guidance. Management projects a recovery to 25-30% margins by Q2-Q3 FY27, alongside substantial capacity expansion (₹130 Cr CAPEX by Q1 FY28) to achieve a FY27 revenue target of ₹350-400 crore, contingent on raw material price stabilization and successful integration.
